user.title: Connect to Google Routes API
user.description: Enter a Google Cloud API key with the Routes API, Geocoding API, and Places API enabled. It will be used to calculate distances from your Home Assistant location.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Distance from Home
reauth_confirm.description: Your Google Routes API key is no longer valid. Enter a new one.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Check that it is correct and that the Routes API and Geocoding API are enabled for it.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Google. Try again later.

user.title: Add a location
user.description: Find the Place ID with Google's Place ID finder: {google_places_website}

data_description.place_id: The Google Maps place ID, for example ChIJN1t_tDeuEmsRUsoyG83frY4.
data_description.name: Optional. Leave blank to use the name Google has for the place.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure location
reconfigure.description: Update the destination Place ID and travel modes.

error.no_modes_selected: Select at least one travel mode.
error.invalid_place_id: Could not compute a route to this Place ID. Check that it is correct.
error.name_lookup_failed: Could not look up a name for this Place ID from Google. Enter a name manually.
